criteria.text: The participant has a histological or cytological diagnosis of locally advanced or metastatic ER+HER2- breast cancer, CRPC, or NSCLC that is intolerant or resistant to standard therapy or for which no standard therapy is available.
The participant has a histological or cytological diagnosis of locally advanced or metastatic ER+HER2- breast cancer.
The participant has progressed after at least 1 prior line of treatment with an endocrine therapy and CDK4/6 inhibitor in the advanced or metastatic setting.
The participant has a histological or cytological diagnosis of locally advanced or metastatic ER+HER2- breast cancer.
The participant has progressed after at least 1 prior line of CDK4/6 inhibitor and 1 line of endocrine therapy.
The participant has a histological or cytological diagnosis of advanced or metastatic ER+HER2- breast cancer.
The participant has progressive disease after at least 1 prior line of a CDK4/6 inhibitor and at least 1 prior line of endocrine therapy.
The participant has not received more than 3 prior lines of systemic therapies including up to 1 line of cytotoxic chemotherapy for visceral disease in advanced or metastatic setting.
The participant may have prior treatment with fulvestrant.
The participant has a histological or cytological diagnosis of advanced or metastatic ER+HER2- breast cancer.
The participant has progressive disease after at least 1 prior line of a CDK4/6 inhibitor and at least 1 prior line of endocrine therapy.
The participant has not received more than 3 lines of systemic therapies including up to 1 line of cytotoxic chemotherapy for visceral disease in advanced or metastatic setting.
The participant may have prior treatment with fulvestrant.
The participant has a histological or cytological diagnosis of advanced or metastatic ER+HER2- breast cancer.
The participant has progressive disease after at least 1 prior line of a CDK4/6 inhibitor and at least 1 prior line of endocrine therapy.
The participant has not received more than 3 lines of systemic therapies including up to 1 line of cytotoxic chemotherapy for visceral disease in advanced or metastatic setting.
The participant may have received fulvestrant.
The participant has documentation of ER-positive tumor (≥1% positive stained cells) based on most recent tumor biopsy utilizing an assay consistent with local standards.

The participant has documentation of HER2-negative tumor: HER2-negative tumor is determined as immunohistochemistry score 0/1+ or negative by in situ hybridization (FISH/CISH/SISH/DISH) defined as a HER2/CEP17 ratio <2 or for single probe assessment a HER2 copy number <4.

Female participants with ER+HER2- advanced or metastatic breast cancer considered to be of childbearing potential (or have tubal ligations only) are willing to undergo medically induced menopause by treatment with the approved LHRH agonist such as goserelin, leuprolide or equivalent agents to induce chemical menopause.
Female participants with ER+HER2- advanced or metastatic breast cancer of nonchildbearing potential meet at least 1 criteria of achieving postmenopausal status.
The participant has at least 1 measurable lesion as defined by RECIST version 1.1 that has not been previously irradiated.
The participant has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status PS 0 or 1.
The participant is female or male and aged ≥ 18 years (Japan ≥ 20 years) (South Korea ≥ 19 years).
The participant has adequate renal, liver, and bone marrow function.
The participant has resolved acute effects of any prior therapy to baseline severity or CTCAE Grade 1 except for adverse events (AEs) not constituting a safety risk by investigator judgment.
The participant has unmanageable ascites.
The participant has any other active malignancy within 3 years prior to enrollment, except for adequately treated basal cell or squamous cell skin cancer, or carcinoma in situ.
The participant has had major surgery, radiation therapy, or systemic anti-cancer therapy within 3 weeks prior to study entry.
The participant has had prior irradiation to >25% of the bone marrow.

The participant has ECG clinically relevant abnormalities (eg, QTc >470 msec, complete LBBB, second/third degree AV block, ST elevation or EKG changes suggesting myocardial infarction or active myocardia ischemia).
The participant is on therapeutic anticoagulation.
The participant has known or suspected hypersensitivity or severe allergy to active ingredient/excipients of PF-07248144.

The participant has active inflammatory GI disease, refractory and unresolved chronic diarrhea or previous gastric resection, lap band surgery or other GI conditions and surgeries that may significantly alter the absorption of PF-07248144 tablets.
The participant is a pregnant or breastfeeding female.

P1.text: Part 1A (Monotherapy Dose Escalation) Histological or cytological diagnosis of locally advanced or metastatic ER+HER2- breast cancer, CRPC, or NSCLC that is intolerant or resistant to standard therapy or for which no standard therapy is available.

P2.text: Part 1B, Part 1C, Part 1D and Part 1E (Combination Dose Escalation) Histological or cytological diagnosis of locally advanced or metastatic ER+HER2- breast cancer.

P5.text: Participants must have progressed after at least 1 prior line of CDK4/6 inhibitor and 1 line of endocrine therapy.

P6.text: Part 2B (ER+HER2- breast cancer 2-4L, combination with fulvestrant) Histological or cytological diagnosis of advanced or metastatic ER+HER2- breast cancer.

P7.text: Participants must have progressive disease after at least 1 prior line of a CDK4/6 inhibitor and at least 1 prior line of endocrine therapy..

P8.text: Participants must not have received more than 3 prior lines of systemic therapies including up to 1 line of cytotoxic chemotherapy for visceral disease in advanced or metastatic setting;

P9.text: Participants may have but are not required to have prior treatment with fulvestrant.

P10.text:

Histological or cytological diagnosis of advanced or metastatic ER+HER2- breast cancer.

P11.text: Participants must have progressive disease after at least 1 prior line of a CDK4/6 inhibitor and at least 1 prior line of endocrine therapy.

P12.text: Participants must have not received more than 3 lines of systemic therapies including up to 1 line of cytotoxic chemotherapy for visceral disease in advanced or metastatic setting;

P13.text: Participants may have but are not required to have prior treatment with fulvestrant.

P14.text: Part 2E (ER+HER2- breast cancer 2-4L, combination with vepdegestrant): Histological or cytological diagnosis of advanced or metastatic ER+HER2- breast cancer.

P15.text: Participants must have progressive disease after at least 1 prior line of a CDK4/6 inhibitor and at least 1 prior line of endocrine therapy;

P16.text: Participants must have not received more than 3 lines of systemic therapies including up to 1 line of cytotoxic chemotherapy for visceral disease in advanced or metastatic setting;

P18.text: Participants with ER+HER2- advanced or metastatic breast cancer must have documentation of ER-positive tumor (≥1% positive stained cells) based on most recent tumor biopsy utilizing an assay consistent with local standards.

P19.text: Participants with ER+HER2- advanced or metastatic breast cancer must have documentation of HER2-negative tumor: HER2-negative tumor is determined as immunohistochemistry score 0/1+ or negative by in situ hybridization (FISH/CISH/SISH/DISH) defined as a HER2/CEP17 ratio \<2 or for single probe assessment a HER2 copy number \<4.

P20.text: Female participants with ER+HER2- advanced or metastatic breast cancer considered to be of childbearing potential (or have tubal ligations only) must be willing to undergo medically induced menopause by treatment with the approved LHRH agonist such as goserelin, leuprolide or equivalent agents to induce chemical menopause.

P21.text: Female participants with ER+HER2- advanced or metastatic breast cancer of nonchildbearing potential must meet at least 1 criteria of achieving postmenopausal status.

P22.text: Participants must have at least 1 measurable lesion as defined by RECIST version 1.1 that has not been previously irradiated.

P23.text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status PS 0 or 1

P24.text: Female or male patients aged ≥ 18 years (Japan ≥ 20 years) (South Korea ≥ 19 years).

P25.text: Adequate renal, liver, and bone marrow function.

P26.text: Resolved acute effects of any prior therapy to baseline severity or CTCAE Grade 1 except for adverse events (AEs) not constituting a safety risk by investigator judgment.

P27.text: Unmanageable ascites (limited medical treatment to control ascites is permitted, but all participants with ascites require review by sponsor's medical monitor).

P28.text: Participants with any other active malignancy within 3 years prior to enrollment, except for adequately treated basal cell or squamous cell skin cancer, or carcinoma in situ.

P29.text: Major surgery, radiation therapy, or systemic anti-cancer therapy within 3 weeks prior to study entry.

P30.text: Prior irradiation to \>25% of the bone marrow.

P31.text: ECG clinically relevant abnormalities (eg, QTc \>470 msec, complete LBBB, second/third degree AV block, ST elevation or EKG changes suggesting myocardial infarction or active myocardia ischemia).

P32.text: Therapeutic anticoagulation. However, low molecular weight heparin is allowed. Vitamin K antagonists or factor Xa inhibitors may be allowed following discussion with the Sponsor.

P33.text: Known or suspected hypersensitivity or severe allergy to active ingredient/excipients of PF-07248144.

P34.text: Active inflammatory GI disease, refractory and unresolved chronic diarrhea or previous gastric resection, lap band surgery or other GI conditions and surgeries that may significantly alter the absorption of PF-07248144 tablets. Gastroesophageal reflux disease under treatment is allowed.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: These questions are about the trial "Study of PF-07248144 in Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors". Your earlier answers already covered 5 of its rules. I'll ask about the rest of its rules one at a time. You can skip any question, and "I don't know" is always fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you been diagnosed with locally advanced or metastatic ER+HER2- breast cancer? (ER+HER2- means the cancer cells have estrogen receptors but not HER2 proteins.) If you aren't sure, that's okay.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I have non-small cell lung cancer, specifically adenocarcinoma. I haven't been diagnosed with breast cancer.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you received treatment with both an endocrine therapy and a CDK4/6 inhibitor for your cancer? (Endocrine therapy uses hormones to treat cancer; CDK4/6 inhibitors are a type of targeted therapy.) If you aren't sure, that's okay.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't. I've only had targeted therapies for my lung cancer, specifically alectinib and now lorlatinib.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: How many different systemic cancer treatments have you received so far? This includes hormone therapy, targeted therapy, and chemotherapy. Please include the current treatment you are on.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I've had two systemic treatments since my cancer became advanced: first alectinib, and now lorlatinib.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you ever received a treatment called fulvestrant? If you aren't sure, that's okay.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't. I've only had targeted therapies for my lung cancer, specifically alectinib and now lorlatinib.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have documentation from your most recent tumor biopsy showing that your tumor is ER-positive (meaning at least 1% of the cells tested positive for estrogen receptors)?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I don't have that. My biopsy showed adenocarcinoma, and my molecular testing was for lung cancer markers like ALK and EGFR, not estrogen receptors.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have documentation showing your tumor is HER2-negative? This is often reported as IHC 0 or 1+, or negative by FISH testing. If you aren't sure, that's okay.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, my panel testing confirmed HER2 negative. I don't have the specific IHC or FISH report numbers, but the result was negative.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To confirm, are you 18 years of age or older?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I am 49 years old, so I am definitely 18 or older.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you had recent blood tests (within the last 7 days) to check your kidney, liver, and bone marrow function?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know. I haven't had recent blood tests within the last 7 days.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you had any side effects from your previous cancer treatments that are still bothering you or haven't gone back to your normal baseline?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know about specific lingering side effects. I'm fully active and still running and working full time, so I don't feel like anything is bothering me.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you currently have a buildup of fluid in your abdomen (ascites) that is difficult to manage or causing significant discomfort?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I don't have ascites. My metastases are in the pleura, liver, and brain, but I haven't mentioned any abdominal fluid buildup.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you had any major surgery, radiation therapy, or systemic anti-cancer treatment in the last 3 weeks?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had any major surgery, radiation, or systemic treatment in the last 3 weeks. I had no radiation to the chest in the last 6 months, and my last treatments were alectinib and lorlatinib, which were not recent.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever had radiation therapy that covered more than 25% of your bone marrow?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had radiation therapy covering more than 25% of my bone marrow. I haven't had any radiation at all.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been told by a doctor that you have any clinically significant abnormalities on an ECG, such as an irregular heartbeat or changes in heart rhythm?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know. I haven't been told about any ECG abnormalities. I know my heart is fine because I run and work full time, but I don't have specific ECG results.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To be sure, have you ever had an ECG (heart tracing) that showed a prolonged QT interval, a block in the heart's electrical system, or signs of a heart attack or reduced blood flow to the heart?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know. I haven't had an ECG recently, so I'm not sure about my QT interval or any heart blocks. I just know I'm fully active and my heart feels fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you currently taking any blood thinners (anticoagulants) for treatment, such as warfarin, apixaban, rivaroxaban, or heparin?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I am not currently taking any blood thinners like warfarin or apixaban.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you have any known or suspected severe allergies to the active ingredient or other components of PF-07248144?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I don't have any known severe allergies to PF-07248144 or its components.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you currently have active inflammatory bowel disease, ongoing severe diarrhea, or have you had stomach or intestinal surgeries (like gastric resection or lap band) that might affect how your body absorbs medication?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I don't have active inflammatory bowel disease or any stomach or intestinal surgeries. I'm fully active and working full time, so my digestive system seems fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you currently pregnant or breastfeeding?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Not applicable, I'm male.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that's all my questions. Your record for this trial is ready, for you and your oncologist. They and the trial team decide whether it is right for you.
